# AYESMAJ Studios

> A multi-discipline creative studio based in Phoenix, Arizona, working worldwide. AYESMAJ Studios builds brand identity, cinematic content, premium websites, AI content production, and immersive 3D as one connected creative system.

Founder: Rafael Smadja
Contact: ayesmajstudios@gmail.com
Location: Phoenix, Arizona, USA — working worldwide

## Services

- [Brand Strategy & Identity](https://ayesmajstudios.com/ServiceBranding): Positioning, logo systems, and visual language.
- [Premium Websites](https://ayesmajstudios.com/WebExperiences): Cinematic sites engineered to convert.
- [AI Content Production](https://ayesmajstudios.com/AiMarketing): AI images, posts, and campaigns at scale.
- [3D & CGI](https://ayesmajstudios.com/Worlds3D): Product modeling, environments, photoreal renders.
- [Motion, Film & VFX](https://ayesmajstudios.com/AiVideos): Commercials, brand films, launch reels.
- [Storyboards & Direction](https://ayesmajstudios.com/Storyboards): Visual treatments and campaign direction.
